Hold responsibility for the technical support of manufacturing development and integration for production. Resolve issues pertaining to vendor schedule and/or quality. Utilize root cause analysis, preventative and corrective action to reduce/eliminate non-conformances. Manage the implementation of tooling and or production planning, from original concept through to production; Design these processes with a high degree of process capability utilizing the GKN standard Zero Defect Manufacturing (ZDM) tool suite to demonstrate as such. Oversee the product development, first article development, configuration changes, build process definition and implementation; Deliver measurable, metrics driven results in line with Operational & Program goals. Maintain positive, team relationships with internal and external customers, as well as co-workers. Continuously improve production processes by implementing Lean initiatives. Working knowledge of quality system models such as ISO9000, AS9100, or D1-9000. Quality driven and strong documentation / reporting skills. Fluency in English, both in writing & speaking. What We'll Offer A challenging position in an innovative and international environment with a rich history in aircraft manufacturing. Our organization breathes passion for engineering and all our teams are justifiably proud of what they develop and build. As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will receive a fantastic range of benefits, including: A competitive compensation package, with salary determined based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. 42 paid holidays for full-time employment (29 holidays and 13 permanent ADV days). Working conditions according to the CAO Metalektro, including an excellent pension scheme and travel allowance. A working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers. Every opportunity to build on your career and personal development. Extra info Apply online by sending us your CV. Due to data privacy reasons we do not handle any applications sent by email. Assessment of checks and screenings can lead to the fact that no content can be given to the position and therefore no employment or deployment can follow. The onboarding at Fokker usually takes 3-4 weeks. We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go? A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work. We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know. Scoprire nuovi orizzonti, crescere in una realtà dinamica, condividere la passione per i brand. Per te abbiamo un ruolo da Merchandiser Allestitore: l’inizio di una carriera nel mondo del field marketing. Avrai l’opportunità di viaggiare nella tua regione affrontando ogni giorno nuove sfide per raggiungere specifici obiettivi. Avrai tutta la libertà e flessibilità di organizzare al meglio il tuo lavoro in base ai tuoi interessi e ai tuoi impegni. Perché in CPM Italy siamo convinti che i tuoi risultati passano anche attraverso la qualità della tua vita. Ok, ma cosa farai di preciso? Il tuo ruolo consiste nell'effettuare una serie di interventi all'interno di punti vendita della Grande Distribuzione Organizzata (GDO), con l'obiettivo di garantire la corretta esposizione dei prodotti e migliorare la visibilità del brand. Non sarai solo ma sempre in contatto con altri colleghi, i professionisti del punto vendita e in costante dialogo con la sede CPM di Milano. Requisiti Sei tu la persona giusta? Per diventare Merchandiser Allestitore può essere utile un’esperienza nel ruolo. Non servono competenze specifiche ma è fondamentale l’attitudine alla relazione, la voglia di comunicare e di entrare in sintonia con le persone. In più è fantastico se… > sei una persona curiosa con tanta voglia di imparare; > ami i brand e ti appassiona farli crescere; > hai la patente B (e sai guidare sul serio!); > ti piace l’idea di viaggiare per lavoro.
